record.title: Zero Trust Dashboard - Posture Check Visibility Issue

updates.body:
Cloudflare is aware of, and implementing a fix for individual device posture checks not showing on the Devices Page.  Device posture checks in the meantime can be inspected through the Logs -> Posture Logs.  

This is purely a dashboard visibility issue— firewall policies are not impacted.
An effective fix for this issue has been implemented and this incident is now resolved.
